title: 4 weeks of tokens on Claude, I built my own exploration focused RPG
author: junesforge
selftext:
Firstly, I know I know, I saw the [other post](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/s/Ta3RmG8YVK) on this sub. I think it's delightful. And funnily, 17 years ago, I too was 14. Albeit in India.

Okay, longish post btw.

And this game very much still under development btw, but I intend to keep building it.  
Anyway, so last year this time I was only starting to do some text based game dev with Gemini tokens (ugh), trying to make a simple browser based RPG. Back then I used to be a pure web developer, with zero idea of game design. Even today I have zero 3D modeling experience btw xD

But I have played a fair number of games.  
  
I used to play this game back in my childhood called FallenSword and I loved how it made a whole world accessible even on the slower connections back then. It was text based RPG with a simple map. What I liked about that game, and games like RuneScape is the surface area they cover across the world, the terrain, with the skilling and stuff, ykwim? Like, I've played Genshin and Wuthering Waves, and while I love how gorgeous the games are, I like the intensity in one skill vertical. 

Although Genshin/WuWa have a deep imprint on my design sensibilities too. I wanted an attractive character as the lead, and my game had to run in the browser. Accessibility is important. So I set myself a limit of 3-5 characters max. A character is heavy on the browser to load and run, performance wise.

Last and most importantly, the ship stuff from AC Black Flag is something I haven't been able to forget, growing up, having moved on to a Macbook. Had to put in some naval stuff. 

So, if I were to list down my main objectives and constraints:  
\- Realistic goal: Aim for 30-45 minutes of joy for someone, in a browser.  
\- Free 3D models only.  
\- Visuals are important, but "feel" is more important.  
\- Attractive, but limited characters.   
\- Some nice soundtracks if possible  
\- Lots of different things to do - sail a ship, fly a bike (currently hidden btw), hunt, fight, pet a dog!!  
\- as light on the browser as possible, but then stop optimising  
\- feel good factor, make it cozy, do not make a casual gamer feel dumb  
\- my mum should be able to play it (if not today, once all the tutorials are in place)

So yeah, here's my ode to gaming. My favourite project of all time. As mentioned, things are still in works:  
\- More skilling stuff  
\- Quests!  
\- Zones 2 (caribbean vibes) and zone 3 (underwater vibes)  
\- optimising the ending

I think what I will take away from this project is just HOW much I learnt and how much goes in game development. It's definitely not a one person's job, and it surely helped that I do come from a design background, but I sorely missed someone with a music sensibility, and a 3D artist. I think the parts I loved would be the world design (because I heckin love history geography politics), and using tricks to hide what you don't know or can't handle xD 

Feedback welcome! :3

replies.author: junesforge
replies.body:
Agreed. Mostly my fault here for not explaining things better. Many more tutorials, before I sleep.   
I've now updated the game.   
1) The game will tell you "R" switches you into bow mode. And "F" to lock onto an enemy.  
1.5) It *should* tell you about the bow/FPV mode in general, and that combat doesn't work on animals.   
2) Sword was a bit of a design choice. So I didn't want to mess with my character holding a weapon, for some reason that isn't practical, at least. Plus most of my animations come from Mixamo and I spotted this MMA set, and I was like "Hmm, how about I overlay MMA animations over a weapon flourish?", and here's the result. I'll note your feedback :3  
3) Astra yes, is making ripples I've noticed, will definitely give it a shot when the cashflow supports it xD
